differs_from_row: OR puts the XII Corps' advance from Two Taverns earlier than 17:30: Geary was at Two Taverns at 11 a.m. and advanced about 3 p.m.; Williams' division was already at the Hanover road hill and ordered to withdraw when the retreat was known (no hour); Slocum himself arrived between 5 and 6 p.m. (Hancock).
note: Slocum's arrival (about 18:00, 'between 5 and 6') is supported (T1-177). Geary's position: 'extreme left of the line' near Round Top rather than on Cemetery Ridge proper.
